stronger_left_out.name: Mount Hakepa
stronger_left_out.reason: For: tourism board 'bucket list' stand at the first place in the world to greet the new day (North Head, Pitt Island). Against: one counted source, no article, not on Wikivoyage, on a farm with homestay access. Coordinates (no OSM/Nominatim: both returned 429 for me): the only sourced point is Wikivoyage 'Hakepa Homestays, North Head Farm' -44.2702,-176.1656, which is the farm, not the summit; verify before placing.

review_list.name: Mission Bay Ruins (Te Whakaru)
review_list.reason: Merged with Te Whakaru (same site on the Murchison/Muirson farm: Wikivoyage 'Mission Bay', -43.73965,-176.21376; tourism board 'Te Whakaru': old cemetery, German mission remnants and shipwreck sites), so it now has two counted sources, but those are one farm visit arranged by phone with the same contact as Point Munning and the flying boat. For: two sources, history. Against: ruins and a cemetery only, arranged visit, little to do. Keep as one review entry under this name; Te Whakaru stays rejected as the duplicate.

review_list.name: Nunuku's Cave
review_list.reason: For: Wikivoyage See entry (-43.86055,-176.5242) says the cave has authentic ancient rock carvings and the Nunuku story. Against: one counted source, tourism board does not list it, no access or visit information, so cannot confirm a visitor can enter. Stays review.

review_list.name: Tommy Solomon Statue
review_list.reason: For: Wikivoyage (-44.03327,-176.33631) and tourism board ('a must-visit for all travellers') both name it; stop pairs with Manakau, the descendants' property. Against: a 1985 statue, a minor memorial and short roadside stop on the same terms as the Bridge of Remembrance; the Wikipedia views (29k) are for the person, not the statue. Owner call.

review_list.name: Sunderland NZ4111 Flying Boat
review_list.reason: For: Wikivoyage (-43.73649,-176.24567) and the tourism board ('a surprising encounter', relatively intact 1945 fuselage) both name it. Against: kept in a shed on the private Muirson/Murchison farm at Kaiwhata, access only through the farm contact (021 731 634), under restoration, and a ten-minute look. Owner call.

review_list.name: Mount Hakepa
review_list.reason: For: tourism board 'bucket list' stand at the first place in the world to greet the new day (North Head, Pitt Island). review_list.name: Splatter Rock
review_list.reason: For: tourism board names Wharekauri Station and 'Taniwha / Splatter Rock' with a Maori legend. Against: one counted source, a private working station visited by arrangement (027 618 5718), exact location not given, no second source. Stays review.

review_list.name: Contemplation Bay
review_list.reason: For: tourism board describes a 300 m limestone bay as 'awe-inspiring'; a real scenic stop. Against: one source, no location or access given anywhere (not on Wikivoyage, DOC or Wikipedia, and OSM lookups were rate-limited), so it cannot be pinned. Stays review pending coordinates.

strongest_outsiders: None: the whole group lies within 67.5 km of the destination centre, so no kept place is outside every span. Strongest left out: Tommy Solomon Statue (29481 views, review), Air Chathams Pitt Island Flight (16321, vehicle), Tuuta Airport (6945).
benchmark: No national benchmark place lies in this region. Consistent with the negative benchmarks: the Air Chathams flight (a vehicle) is rejected in favour of the Pitt Island spot, and the Tommy Solomon Statue (minor memorial) stays in review.
